title: centaurium tenuiflorum subsp. viridense
intro: Centaurium tenuiflorum subsp. viridense, commonly known as Mountain centaury, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Gentianaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various conditions such as digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain centaury include stimulating digestion and improving wound healing due to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications in traditional medicine.
